# Site assets

- `zerodha-logo.svg`: existing Zerodha wordmark. Header display width is 130px,
  with its native aspect ratio preserved.
- `InterVariable.woff2`: Inter v4.1 variable font, normal weights 100 to 900,
  from https://github.com/rsms/inter/blob/v4.1/docs/font-files/InterVariable.woff2.
  See `Inter-LICENSE.txt` for the SIL Open Font License.
- `oat/`: vendored Oat 1.0.0 CSS and JavaScript; see its README and MIT license.

- `favicon.png`: official 48 × 48 Zerodha favicon, reused from
  https://zerodha.com/static/images/favicon.png on 2026-11-02.

## Landing illustrations

The files in `illustrations/` are unmodified Zerodha brand assets reused from
https://zerodha.com/products/mcp/, downloaded on 2026-11-02:

- `kite-mcp-3.svg`: https://zerodha.com/static/images/kite-mcp-3.svg (hero).
- `kite-mcp-2.svg`: https://zerodha.com/static/images/kite-mcp-2.svg (account connection).
- `kite-mcp-1.svg`: https://zerodha.com/static/images/kite-mcp-1.svg (security).
- `kite-mcp-5.webp`: https://zerodha.com/static/images/kite-mcp-5.webp (compatible clients).

These remain Zerodha brand assets. Conversation prompts are HTML text, adapted
from the product page so they remain readable and accessible at every screen size.
The prompts and illustrations are examples, not live account data.
Fonts and runtime assets are served locally, without requests to third-party CDNs.
